initial_decision.brief_rationale: Lottery assignment independent of both potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference identify the causal risk difference. The exact population risks are 8/80 = 0.10 and 24/120 = 0.20, giving 0.10 − 0.20 = −0.10.
